scope: All 150 unique entries in the cited API index, plus narrative review of lower-level APIs. This is a source/contract mapping, not a 150-case differential test or full CadQuery coverage percentage. Latest docs are mutable and may differ from the pinned source.

statuses.supported_domain: Native analogous operation exists within its stated contract; not identical signature or complete behavioral equivalence.
statuses.partial: Relevant native capability exists, with material semantic/domain gaps.
statuses.recipe: Caller may compose existing primitives; a dedicated equivalent is absent and not generally verified.
statuses.unsupported: No corresponding public contract currently offered.
statuses.different_abstraction: A deliberate graph/session/typed-JSON alternative; no API substitution.
